title: Whispered Words
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sumika, a tall karate prodigy, is secretly in love with her best friend Ushio, who likes girls too but only 'cute and small' ones. Around them are a classmate boy who cross-dresses to get Sumika's attention, an openly lesbian couple who try to found a girls' club, and a German exchange student who brings Sumika back to karate. Over high school, Ushio slowly realizes her own feelings.
life_message: Being honest about who you are and who you love, and growing strong in your own way, matters more than becoming someone else's 'type'.

content.note: Karate training and tournaments; a junior punches a student who insults Sumika (Wikipedia; AniList Martial Arts).
Teen same-sex romance and crushes; a boy cross-dresses (Wikipedia; AniList Yuri; MangaDex safe).
Ushio breaks down in depression; Sumika's distress at not being 'cute' enough; homophobia tagged (Wikipedia; MU Homophobia).
Reckless driving by Tomoe and a student punching another (Wikipedia).

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Fights stay in the dojo; one student punishes an insult and is penalized (Wikipedia).

Civic vs kin.evidence: Family dojo and Tomoe's traditional family accept her (Wikipedia).

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Student council and clubs, not rank, matter.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Modern secular school; identity as personal choice.

folkways.japan: School clubs, a family karate dojo and the restraint that keeps feelings unspoken reflect Japanese school and family norms, and yuri is an established manga genre.

delivery.evidence: Summaries show the themes through the friends' choices; no review of delivery found (to verify).
delivery.note: The story centers sympathetic characters; school opposition to Tomoe's girls' club is reported only as a rejected proposal.

winners_losers: The friends' honesty and self-acceptance win; sympathy goes fully to Sumika and Ushio.
